fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
A fresh answer order for each person

The quiz shuffles the answer choices for each person who opens it. The right partner never sits in the same spot twice, and two students at one table see a different order.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A picture matching quiz on a classroom tablet asks 23 first graders to match 8 pictures to sight words, and the 6 children with 3 or more misses join the Tuesday reading group.
